evidence_override.note: Accept a pair the thresholds rejected when the stored lexical reranker score is >= rr_min and model probability >= p_min. rr_score is produced by src/candidate_generation/rerank.py and persisted in cand_*_k80.parquet; it bundles name (0.50), address (0.28), numeric (0.14) and blocking-key agreement (0.08).

inference_requirements: cand_*.parquet must carry rr_score (it already does)
join scored probabilities to candidates on (source1_entity_id, cand_id)
accept = (p >= threshold AND p >= best_p_for_entity * rel_margin) OR (rr_score >= 0.74 AND p >= 0.65)
then keep at most max_k per entity, highest p first

validation.evaluated_on: val (59,999 entities), single evaluation at the dev-locked config
